title: Matrisks Finding
description: A single finding from a Matrisks scan.

id.description: A unique identifier for the finding, in the format VEC-XXX.

title.description: A short, human-readable title for the finding.

summary.description: A one-sentence summary of the finding.

description.description: A more detailed description of the finding, including the vulnerability and its potential impact.

confidence.description: The confidence in the finding, on a scale of 1-5.

suggestion.description: A detailed suggestion for how to fix the vulnerability.

vector.description: The name of the vector that produced the finding.

cwe.description: The CWE ID for the finding, if applicable.

owasp_mobile.description: The OWASP Mobile Top 10 category for the finding, if applicable.

details.description: The detailed evidence for the finding, such as code snippets or file paths.
